headline: Five things moved since the August 31 briefing. Everything else on the register is unchanged and is listed at the foot without being repeated.
scope: Built from the public record alone: filings accepted by EDGAR, press releases, and the company's own pages, read on September 15, 2026. No internal source of any kind.

items.headline: The window to nominate a director for the 2026 annual meeting shut on Sunday, and the meeting date is still not public

chain.label: WHAT HAPPENED
chain.text: The bylaw window for stockholder proposals and director nominations at the 2026 annual meeting shut at the close of business on Sunday, September 13. It had opened on August 14.

sources.title: Definitive proxy statement (DEF 14A) for the December 12, 2025 annual meeting
sources.quote: any stockholder who would like to have a proposal considered at our 2026 annual meeting of stockholders must submit the proposal to the Secretary of the Company [...] not earlier than the close of business on August 14, 2026, and not later than the close of business on September 13, 2026

chain.label: WHAT CHANGED
chain.text: At the last briefing it was open with thirteen days to run. It is shut, and nothing has been filed since to announce the date of the meeting.

sources.title: Definitive proxy statement (DEF 14A) for the December 12, 2025 annual meeting
sources.quote: any stockholder who would like to have a proposal considered at our 2026 annual meeting of stockholders must submit the proposal to the Secretary of the Company [...] not earlier than the close of business on August 14, 2026, and not later than the close of business on September 13, 2026

sources.title: Definitive proxy statement (DEF 14A) for the December 12, 2025 annual meeting
sources.quote: unless the date of our 2026 annual meeting is more than 30 days before or more than 60 days after December 12, 2026, in which case the proposal must be received no later than the 10th day following the day on which public announcement of the date of such meeting is first made

chain.label: WHY IT MATTERS
chain.text: The same paragraph reopens it for ten days after a public announcement if the meeting falls more than 30 days before, or more than 60 days after, December 12. The meeting date, still unset, is what decides whether nominations are shut. Whether a submission on Monday the 14th would count against a Sunday deadline is a question for counsel.

sources.title: Definitive proxy statement (DEF 14A) for the December 12, 2025 annual meeting
sources.quote: unless the date of our 2026 annual meeting is more than 30 days before or more than 60 days after December 12, 2026, in which case the proposal must be received no later than the 10th day following the day on which public announcement of the date of such meeting is first made

chain.label: WHO OWNS IT
chain.text: The bylaws name the Secretary of the Company. Scott Bartley has held that office, with Interim Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, since October 27, 2025.

sources.title: Definitive proxy statement (DEF 14A) for the December 12, 2025 annual meeting
sources.quote: any stockholder who would like to have a proposal considered at our 2026 annual meeting of stockholders must submit the proposal to the Secretary of the Company [...] not earlier than the close of business on August 14, 2026, and not later than the close of business on September 13, 2026

sources.title: Form 8-K, Item 5.02: appointment of an Interim Chief Financial Officer
sources.quote: On October 27, 2025, the Board of Directors [...] appointed Scott Bartley, as Interim Chief Financial Officer, Treasurer and Secretary of the Company

chain.label: WHAT IS LATE
chain.text: Nothing. A window shut on its own terms, and the June 30 deadline for proposals printed in the proxy has already gone by.

sources.title: Definitive proxy statement (DEF 14A) for the December 12, 2025 annual meeting
sources.quote: in order for a stockholder proposal to be included in the Company's proxy statement for its 2026 annual meeting, such proposal must be received at the Company's principal executive offices

chain.label: WHAT DECISION IS REQUIRED
chain.text: Set the date of the 2026 annual meeting. That one choice settles this window, the proxy calendar and item five.

chain.label: WHAT TO DO NEXT
chain.text: Next board agenda. Ask the Secretary to confirm on the record what came in between August 14 and September 13.

items.headline: Your public record disagrees with itself about the size of your board, in three places
answers: WHAT SHOULD I KNOW THAT NOBODY HAS DIRECTLY TOLD ME
items.new_since_previous: the company's own board page was read on September 15 and still shows six directors, sixty one days after the seventh was appointed

chain.label: WHAT HAPPENED
chain.text: Item 5.02 of the Form 8-K of July 22 says the Board went from six directors to seven. The press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to that same filing says five to six. The Executive Team page shows the Chairman and five directors, six names.

sources.title: Form 8-K, Item 5.02: appointment of a seventh director
sources.quote: increased the size of the Board from six directors to seven directors and appointed Matthew Kreps to the Board

sources.title: Press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to the July 22, 2026 Form 8-K
sources.quote: it has increased the size of its Board of Directors from five to six directors and has appointed Matt Kreps as a director of the Company

sources.title: Executive Team and Board Members page on astrotechcorp.com
sources.quote: Board Members [...] Tom Wilkinson Lead Independent Director [...] Bob McFarland Director [...] John Halinski Director [...] Eric Stober Director [...] Charles Winn Director

chain.label: WHAT CHANGED
chain.text: The contradiction inside the July 22 filing was in the last briefing. New is the reconciliation: the board page, read on September 15, is sixty one days behind the July 16 board action. The same page lists no Chief Financial Officer, while an Interim Chief Financial Officer has been in office since October 27, 2025.

sources.title: Executive Team and Board Members page on astrotechcorp.com
sources.quote: Board Members [...] Tom Wilkinson Lead Independent Director [...] Bob McFarland Director [...] John Halinski Director [...] Eric Stober Director [...] Charles Winn Director

sources.title: Executive Team and Board Members page on astrotechcorp.com
sources.quote: Nihanth Badugu is the Chief Operating Officer of Astrotech Corporation [...] As Chief Product Officer at Astrotech Corporation

sources.title: Form 8-K, Item 5.02: appointment of an Interim Chief Financial Officer
sources.quote: On October 27, 2025, the Board of Directors [...] appointed Scott Bartley, as Interim Chief Financial Officer, Treasurer and Secretary of the Company

chain.label: WHY IT MATTERS
chain.text: Six directors stood for election on December 12, 2025, so the Item 5.02 figure is the one that agrees with the record. The press release is the document that travels: data vendors and proxy advisers read it first, and a counterparty checks the website second. The 2026 proxy will have to state one number, with seven names under it.
